newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan likely to sanction more sugar imports.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan likely to sanction more sugar imports.

text.p: A meeting of senior Pakistani officials set for Thursday is likely to decide to import more sugar, an official of the state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan said on Tuesday.
He said the regular weekly meeting, to be held in Islamabad, would assess the availability and prices of sugar.

It is likely to decide on the import of 50,000 tonnes of sugar in addition to 225,000 tonnes already ordered for shipment by the end of this month, the official said. Private sector importers had also booked some sugar cargoes but quantities were not known. --Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
